Exercise: Single-Arm Linear Jammer

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- knee_extension
- shoulder_abduction
- hip
- extension

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- chest
- triceps

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- developing_shoulder_and_triceps_strength
- improving_hip_and_knee_extension_power

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Recent shoulder surgery

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Linear Jammer, equipment: dumbbells
- name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Linear Jammer, equipment: kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Lateral Raise, equipment: dumbbells
- exercise_name: Seated Single-Arm Overhead Press, equipment: barbell or dumbbells

Instructions:

- Position a bar into a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight.
- Raise the bar from the floor, taking it to your shoulders with one or both hands. Adopt a wide stance. This will be your starting position.
- Perform the movement by extending the elbow, pressing the weight up. Move explosively, extending the hips and knees fully to produce maximal force.
- Return to the starting position.
